svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 06/12 Concrete Modern (Uncommon)
svg.desc: The first buildings are sculpted concrete with deep sunshades. At night they look like the future did once. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
